provenance: Balbaa2022 (DOI 10.3390/jmmp6010002), transcribed 2026-07-30 from repo copy references/docs/Balbaa2022_multiscale-RS-LPBF-IN625_JMMP-6-2.pdf; thermal Table 1/2 inputs identical to V1 (see ../v1-single-track/inputs/balbaa-model.json) and are NOT repeated here
quarantine_note: V-track only; never enters main-case inputs and vice versa. See SPEC.md for the Kaschnitz-tables edge case (D-V2-04).

multitrack_model.type: sequentially coupled: pure heat transfer, then static stress with imported temperature fields

substrate.footprint: flush with layer per Fig 3 (in-plane size not stated in text, D-V2-05)
substrate.mesh_as_printed: coarser, element size biased 40 um (top) -> 140 um (bottom); grading law unstated, D-V2-06

multitrack_model.scan_strategy: stripe scan, serpentine motion [50]; stripe width unstated (D-V2-09)
multitrack_model.step_time_as_printed: total time to expose a 10 mm x 10 mm layer cross-section, 'same size as the experiments' -- although the modeled layer is 4 x 4 mm (paradox, D-V2-08)

thermal_bc.preheat_scope: whole model + fixed at substrate bottom

stress_model.activation: quiet/inactive elements activated inside a circle with diameter = melt-pool width from the thermal model (UEPACTIVATIONVOL); a spot-diameter element set pre-activated to avoid convergence issues
stress_model.numerics_as_printed: unsymmetric stiffness storage; strain-state extrapolation off
stress_model.mechanical_bc: not stated for the multi-track stress model (D-V2-13)

multitrack_model.extraction: temperature history at the powder-layer center point

multilayer_cube_model.part_mesh: DC3D8 200 um; one element = lump of 5 x 40 um physical layers

substrate.extent: NOT stated; figure-derived ~30 x 30 x 6 mm (D-V2-07)

multilayer_cube_model.heat_source: point source via event series + toolpath-mesh intersection (UMDFLUX); acceptable because spot << element (D-V2-10 for our volumetric mapping)
multilayer_cube_model.event_series: MATLAB-generated: time, coordinates, power, spot diameter; recoat events with recoat time 5 s
multilayer_cube_model.scan_strategy: stripe + serpentine in-layer; 0-90 deg alternating between layers (Fig 5)
multilayer_cube_model.layer_lumping_semantics: whether the event series scans all 250 physical layers or 50 mesh layers is not stated (D-V2-11)

stress_model.note: 'thermal strains and stresses were calculated by imposing an initial temperature of 1000 C, above which thermal stress is negligible' (p.11); precedent registered into main-case T_cut design per D-09
stress_model.mechanical_bc: total fixation of substrate bottom surface (p.12)
stress_model.release: substrate removed by ABAQUS model change after build + cooldown; RS in part remains

constitutive_actually_used.warning: Table 4 as printed (A=558 MPa, B=2201.3 MPa, n=0.8, from [65], machining study, ref strain rate 1670/s) was NOT what the RS predictions used. p.33: A, B, n were replaced by the measured as-built tensile values below; C and m kept; same set for all process parameters.

johnson_cook_used.A_source: measured 0.2% yield, as-built LPBF IN625, RT (Fig 40)
johnson_cook_used.B_source: Ramberg-Osgood strength coefficient K from the same test
johnson_cook_used.n_source: Ramberg-Osgood hardening exponent from the same test

constitutive_actually_used.tensile_test_context: ASTM E8 sub-size flat specimen, gauge 25 x 6 x 5 mm; UTS 1191 MPa; E 171 GPa (RT)

elastic_modulus.E_T_rule: literature E(T) offset by (measured - literature) at RT; curve in Fig 41, digitization pending (D-V2-03)

constitutive_actually_used.thermal_expansion: temperature-dependent, cited to [49,63]; curves not printed (D-V2-15)

pyrometer.condition: 220 W, 650 mm/s, hatch 0.12 mm, layer 0.04 mm
pyrometer.instrument: Fluke Endurance two-color pyrometer, Si/Si ~1 um, slope 0.96, range 1000-3000 C, 10 ms response, 2 mm spot at 85 mm, Omnitek L-PBF machine
pyrometer.model_comparison_rule: average element temperatures above 1000 C within a 2 mm circle, sampled at 10 ms increments

xrd_in_depth.protocol: XRD + electropolishing, 0.1 mm increments to 1 mm depth; scan- and hatch-direction stresses; values averaged over a 2 mm diameter spot; profile data in figures only, digitization pending

validation_targets.surface_rs: Balbaa's [50] (Balbaa et al. 2019 IJAMT) surface RS at various parameters, secondary target
